**sdd/issue-814-engine-adapter/proposal**

Full file: openspec/changes/issue-814-engine-adapter/proposal.md (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-814, off origin/main@55700da). Tier lite. Hybrid store.

Authority: maintainer's question round of 2026-09-01 (four decisions), Compuertas 3+4 (28/08), the 05/08 scoping ruling on #323, #312 slice A as shipped.

Intent: SDD_ENGINE becomes the third port (after VCS, MEMORY). gentle-ai legible through a brain-owned adapter; the C4 config verb built (first slice); the role-instructions debt discharged.

Decisions:
- D1: discovery verb writes through the FIRST SLICE of brain:config, built in this change (set/get by key path, schema-validated, migrations run BY the verb, fails closed on unknown keys). Slice grows by need; surface is C4's.
- D2: gentle-ai's declaration RECORDED with _provenance {recorded, endpoint, date} (assertProvenance discipline); NO drift guard — re-recorded by hand when upstream changes.
- D3: `instructions` enters the contract; plain declares a CHECKED null (mirrors model_tier: null); cold-review-prompt.mjs DELETED, review reads the role from the port; ADR-0019 Am.1 c.2 becomes an active constraint (instructions without routing-who-verifies).
- D4: chooses_model: false on every gentle-ai stage; brain-fixes via sdd.map; tiers sonnet→balanced, opus→deep, haiku→cheap.

Scope: brain/scripts/config/ verb slice; gentle-ai.declareRoles; contract growth (instructions); discovery verb; parity n=2 (tripwire deleted because it FAILED).
Non-goals: #815 (mapping ownership), #323 routing, claude/antigravity backends, fields without consumers.
Risks: two consumers (harness+review) — natural seam (config+adapter+parity)/(instructions+review rewiring), decided at tasks with ask-on-risk; deleting cold-review-prompt touches the verdict path (neutrality check required); schemaVersion contested (#806-#809) — follow #806, adjudicate nothing else.
Close semantics: per #816 precedent, closing target chosen at tasks time; #814 closes only when the tripwire is deleted because it failed.
